properties.doc: Whether the fragment's top margin is applied AGAIN where its lines continue on a new page or column.
properties.name: TopMarginAfterBreak

properties.name: LineFitsToDescent

properties.doc: The decimals each wrapped line's origin is written with: every line lands on its own origin rounded to them, halves away from zero, rather than one leading below the last.
properties.name: LinePositionDecimals

properties.doc: How far a block background (BlockBackground) reaches OUTSIDE the block's box on each side, painting only -- nothing else moves.

properties.doc: The corners of a RUN's background (a segment flowing as a run, see SegmentsFlowAsRuns, with a BackgroundColor): the box behind the run's text on each line it reaches - its advance wide, its line box's ascent and descent tall - is rounded at these corners, each line's piece a whole rounded box.
